Each of C, D, E, F, W, X and Z has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Only one person has an exam before X. Only two people have an exam between X and F. Only four people have exams between Z and X. C has an exam immediately after W. D does not have an exam on Monday. How many people have exams between D and E?

Mr. DEF starts from Point A and drives 16 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 21 km, turns right and drives 13 km. He then takes a left turn, drives 15 km, turns right and drives 22 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 54 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 19 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.) 6840
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (18 km to the east) है।

questions.question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.
In row 1, A, B, C and D are seated and all of them are facing south.
In row 2, P, Q, R and S are seated and all of them are facing north.
Thus each person faces another person from the other row. B sits to the immediate right of D. P sits opposite B. R sits to the immediate left of P. The one opposite R is sitting between C and B. S sits second to the right of R. Who amongst them faces S?1900

Given below is a statement (Cause) followed by possible effects numbered I, II and III. Read the Cause carefully and decide which of the three can be possible effect(s).Cause: Over the past decade, the frequency and intensity of storms in Ocean Region X have increased significantly.Effects: I. Shipping companies have rerouted their vessels to avoid Ocean Region X during stormy seasons.II. Local authorities have allocated additional funds for disaster preparedness and response in Ocean Region X.III. Coastal communities in Ocean Region X have experienced a rise in property damage and infrastructure loss.655
options: Only I is a possible effect.
Only II is a possible effect.
All I, II and III are possible effects.
Only II and III are possible effects.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (All I, II and III are possible effects.) है।
